summary: Mobile-only frontend testing of Phase 2 Mobile Calls (LiveKit) on Expo web preview. ALL requested web-observable behaviours PASS end-to-end. Group chat header shows chat-call-audio-btn + chat-call-video-btn; personal_ai (My AI Assistant) header correctly omits both. Tapping chat-call-video-btn from a group chat calls POST /api/calls/start (returns call id) and navigates to /call/[id] which mounts call-screen-web-placeholder (expected on web). call-leave-btn ends the call (POST /api/calls/{id}/end) and returns to the chat. After starting an audio call and going back to the chat, the chat renders the LIVE 'Audio call started' card with a call-join-<callId> button; tapping it navigates back to the call route and re-shows the web placeholder. Chat regressions verified: chat-composer-input + chat-send-btn round-trip works, Human/Combined/AI view switch works (chat-view-human/combined/ai), group-avatar-picker + group-color-* + group-name-input + group-create-btn all present on the New group screen. Onboarding regression: demo-login-btn lands directly on /(tabs) with no onboarding intercept (matches iteration 131).
critical_code_review_comments: chat/[id].tsx line 687: router.push URL builds `title=${encodeURIComponent(title)}` referencing `title` inside renderItem via closure — works today because `title` is derived above in the same render, but if the Join card is ever rendered before `chat` hydrates, `title` will be the fallback 'Chat'. Low priority, cosmetic.

chat/[id].tsx startCall() catches errors into a banner (call-error-banner) which is good, but does not surface a specific error for the personal_ai case since the header buttons are already gated — safe.

call/[id].tsx onLeave() fires POST /api/calls/{id}/end even when navigating in via Join to an already-live call. Server appears to be idempotent (call.state check) but consider a 'leave' vs 'end' distinction for multi-participant calls where a joiner leaving should not tear down the room for everyone. Not testable in web preview.

success_rate.frontend: Phase 2 Mobile Calls: 100% (all 3 requested flows pass on web preview) · Regressions: 100% (chat send / view switch / group avatar picker / demo-login no-onboarding)
